product.supplier: YUBASE-SK (archive folder); document issued by NARMAK TRADE S.R.O.

api_group.calculation_note: Grade-level classification from SK Corporation's paper 'Application of high quality (Group II, III) base oils' (W.-S. Moon, Y.-R. Cho, J.-S. Chun; 6th Annual Fuels & Lubes Asia Conference, Singapore, 28 January 2000), slide 10 'Typical Properties of YUBASE': 'YUBASE-3 (API Gr-II), YUBASE-4 (API Gr-III), YUBASE-6 (API Gr-III)'. The copy is hosted on SlideShare by a third party, and the paper is from 2000. SK Enmove's current page (https://www.skenmove.com/business/base_oil) describes YUBASE as Group III only at brand level; because SK's own paper classes YUBASE-3 as Group II, the brand statement is not used on its own. Not stated in the archived NARMAK TRADE sheet DL2-11304.pdf (2026-10 audit).

chemistry.calculation_note: Historical SK Corporation YUBASE 4 MSDS No. 739-YU4-02, Section 2, reports 100% hydrotreated heavy paraffinic distillate, CAS 64742-54-7. This is an external historical SDS, not the archived NARMAK TRADE property sheet DL2-11304.pdf.

ccs.calculation_note: No grade-specific CCS cold-cranking viscosity measurement, test temperature, or test method is reported in archived YUBASE 4 property sheet DL2-11304.pdf.
